# What should you offer for a laundromat?

> Free laundromat valuation calculator. Enter revenue and costs, a manager and machine reserve, and your loan terms; it shows adjusted cash flow, the most to offer, debt coverage and cash-on-cash. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
